**Regulation to analyze:** FAR 52.204-21 / CMMC Level 1 (escalating to NIST SP 800-171 R2 / CMMC Level 2 when CUI is handled), 48 CFR 52.204-21; 32 CFR Part 170
**Why:** Construction has no sector-specific cyber regulation; the binding obligations most firms face come through federal contracts. The 15 FAR requirements are the minimum; firms handling CUI (e.g., controlled building plans for federal/defense facilities) must meet DFARS 7012/NIST SP 800-171 R2 and CMMC Level 2.
